figures.finding: No source on this was found by the earlier markets research and none was sought today; recorded as not modeled, not as absent. The theatre law was read whole (by search) and is silent on tax; the tax code itself was not reached.

value.theatreLaw: no tax provision (the word 'salgyt' does not occur); the state encourages theatre by concessional credit (ýeňillikli karz) and awards
value.cultureLaw: art. 29: tax and other privileges for culture and its sponsors, terms 'set by legislation' (not found)

blockers.sought: The production incentive's terms for a series (rate, threshold per episode or hour, what counts, cap, date in force), or that it excludes television

attempts.tried: medeniyet.gov.tm: home, /about-ministry, /bildiris (announcements), /category/building/1 (theatres), /category/building/2, /turkmenistanyn-kanuncylygy (legislation list); the Law on Theatre and Theatrical Activity (№ 142-V) and the Law on Culture read whole
attempts.result: Theatre financing (art. 30), non-state subventions (art. 17), pay per legislation (art. 34), culture tax privileges by legislation (Culture art. 29); no screen incentive, fund or commissioning terms; no figures.
